questions.label: Company legal name
questions.ask: What is the legal name of the company that provides the product?
questions.codebase: Footer or legal pages, package.json author, LICENSE copyright line, README. Propose only; the founder confirms.

questions.label: Company address
questions.ask: What is the company's registered or mailing address?
questions.example: 548 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94104, USA
questions.fills: Privacy contact section, DPA Annex I(A)
questions.codebase: Existing legal pages, site footer, email templates (CAN-SPAM footers often contain it).

questions.label: Legal and privacy contact
questions.ask: Which email address should receive legal notices and privacy requests?
questions.fills: Terms notice address, privacy contact, DPA contact
questions.codebase: Existing legal pages, support or contact pages, email sender configuration.

questions.label: Product name
questions.codebase: package.json name, site title or metadata, README heading.

questions.label: Product description
questions.ask: In one or two sentences, what does the product do and for whom?
questions.example: Acme lets finance teams collect and approve vendor invoices.
questions.fills: Terms Cloud Service, DPA Service, privacy scope
questions.codebase: README, landing page hero copy, site metadata description.

questions.label: Website
questions.ask: What is the product's public website address?
questions.fills: Links to pricing, privacy and subprocessor pages
questions.codebase: Site metadata base URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL or similar env examples, deployment config.

questions.label: Where documents are published
questions.ask: Where will these documents be published, so they can link to each other?
options: On our website at /terms, /privacy and so on
Shared from Reconform (we add the links after publishing)
questions.fills: Links between documents: terms to privacy, DPA and subprocessor page; privacy to cookie policy and subprocessor page
questions.codebase: Existing routes or pages named terms, privacy, legal or policies.

questions.label: Customers
questions.ask: Who signs up for the product?
questions.fills: Template fit. These templates are written for B2B SaaS; for consumer products say so and offer to import reviewed documents instead.
questions.codebase: Signup flow fields (company name, workspace, team invites) and pricing tiers.

questions.label: Governing law
questions.ask: Which law should govern your agreements, and where would disputes be heard?
options: New York law, New York courts
England and Wales law and courts
questions.fills: Terms Governing Law and Chosen Courts, NDA and other contracts

questions.label: Backup retention
questions.ask: How long do database backups keep deleted data before they expire?
questions.fills: Terms 5.6(b) deletion exceptions, privacy retention, DPA deletion
questions.codebase: Database provider settings in infrastructure code (point-in-time recovery windows, snapshot retention). Hosted database defaults are not proof of the actual setting.
